title: Level Twenty
tagline: Three against three on the streets. Level your crew to twenty.
menu_campaign_sub: Fifteen fights across three parts of town
menu_random_sub: Two crews drawn from the whole roster. Anything goes
menu_online_sub: Your crew against a friend's, by room code
menu_roster_sub: Pick your three and see how they grow
reset_confirm: Start over from account level 1? Every unit goes back to level 1.
effect_strike: A heavy hit at {power}% of attack.
effect_stun: A hit at {power}% of attack; the target loses its next turn.
effect_sweep: Hits every enemy at {power}% of attack.
effect_heal: Mends the most-hurt ally by {power}% of attack.
effect_drain: A hit at {power}% of attack; heals itself by half the damage.
effect_snipe: Goes for the enemy with least health, at {power}% of attack.
effect_double: Two hits, each at {power}% of attack.
effect_haste: A hit at {power}% of attack, and every other ally's turn comes sooner.
effect_mend: Mends every ally standing by {power}% of attack.
effect_slow: A hit at {power}% of attack; the target's turn is pushed back.
effect_dodge: A hit at {power}% of attack, then a sidestep: the next blow aimed at it misses.
effect_flank: Runs round to the target's side for a hit at {power}% of attack that always counts as strong.
skills_help: A unit learns a skill at levels 1, 5 and 10. Pick the one it uses in fights.
skill_locked: This unit has not learned that skill yet.
pick_slot: Pick a slot in your crew, then pick a unit to put there.
team_need_three: A crew is exactly three units.
team_twice: That unit is already in your crew.
team_locked: Your account level is too low for that unit.
team_unknown: That unit is not on the roster.
stage_locked_label: Win the fight before this one
stage_locked: Win the fight before this one first.
log_stunned: {actor} is stunned and loses the turn
random_note: Random crews are drawn from every unit, locked or not, near your account level. A win pays account XP only.
online_intro: Each of you brings the crew you have, at the levels you have them. The host starts the fight; both browsers work out the same fight from a shared seed.
online_bad_code: That cannot be a room code: four to twelve letters and digits.
online_share: Send this code to the other player.
online_paste: No luck with the code? Swap pasted codes instead
online_paste_host_help: Make an invitation, send it, and paste their reply below.
online_paste_join_help: Paste the host's invitation, make a reply and send it back.
online_bad_paste: That code is not the right kind. An invitation starts with O and a reply with A.
online_host_ready: Ready. Press Fight when you are.
online_joiner_ready: Ready. Waiting for the host to start the fight.
online_full: That room already has two players.
online_wrong_build: The other player has a different version of the game. Both of you reload the page.
online_bad_team: The other player's crew could not be read.
online_garbled: A message from the other player could not be read.
online_crew_changed: You changed your crew after the host started. The next fight will use your new crew.
online_desync: The two browsers worked out different fights. Both of you reload the page.
online_no_relay: Could not reach the relays that introduce players. Try the pasted codes instead.
online_no_path: Your two networks could not connect directly. Try another network, or the pasted codes.
help_triangle: Every unit attacks with melee, magic or ranged. Melee is weak to magic, magic is weak to ranged, and ranged is weak to melee. A hit with the edge does half again as much damage; a hit against it does a bit over two thirds.
help_turns: Fights play themselves. Each unit's turn bar fills at its speed; when it fills, the unit attacks the enemy it has the edge over, or the one with least health. Every few turns it uses its skill instead. Melee units run in and swing, ranged units shoot, and magic users throw what they conjure.
help_levels: Units earn XP from fights and level up to 20. Each level adds HP, attack and speed, and every unit learns a second skill at level 5 and a third at level 10: pick the one it uses on the Crew screen. Your account levels up too, and your account level decides which units you can put in your crew.
help_modes: Campaign is fifteen set fights; stars count the units you had standing at the end. Random draws two crews from the whole roster. Online puts your crew against a friend's.
credits: Drawn in TikZ. A Builder project: every rule runs in a Rust core compiled to WebAssembly.
